public_rationale: The forecast has no deadline. Free access and inexpensive paid inference are consistent with its direction, but do not establish the lasting market outcome Marcus described. Paid access also does not refute an untimed prediction. No decisive event meeting the early-resolution rule was established by the evaluation date.
limitations: Consumer chat, API inference and downloadable weights have different access costs.
A small token price does not establish negligible cost for every workload.
The words supply no fixed standard for how long the proposed endpoint must persist.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: LLMs will not vanish but will ultimately become virtually free.

statement.excerpt: The end game here is not that LLMs will vanish, but that LLMs will be virtually free.
statement.document_title: GenAI’s day of reckoning may have come

our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is that capable LLMs remain available and ordinary use becomes available at negligible user cost across the market.
The forecast concerns access prices, not zero infrastructure costs or zero spending by heavy users.
A free promotional tier alone does not establish a lasting market outcome.
No deadline or numerical near-zero threshold is supplied, so neither is invented.
criteria.support_condition: Durable, broadly available access to capable LLMs makes ordinary use essentially free across the market while LLM services continue to exist.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A decisive permanent disappearance of LLM services would contradict the survival clause. Positive prices at any finite date alone cannot refute the untimed price forecast.

evidence.explanation: The release offered both free and paid access, differentiated by usage. This establishes continuing availability and some free use, but not a durable market-wide endpoint.
Google offered low-priced inference with separate input and output charges. Whether that is virtually free depends on workload; one model's price cannot settle the market-wide forecast.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Durable, representative evidence that ordinary capable LLM use is broadly available at negligible cost, or a decisive disappearance of LLM services. A stated price threshold and deadline would make later assessment more determinate.
